reasons: Datadog nginx.net.conn_dropped_per_s measures dropped connections per second, but the candidate outputs accepted minus handled, a derived difference rather than a direct OTel metric, so the quantity differs.

Per the hard rules, a metric with no direct OTel equivalent that must be computed from other metrics must be blocked with MISSING_METRIC_MAPPING; the candidate should be outcome blocked, with the accepted-minus-handled expression only in notes.
The candidate uses a fixed [5m] range, which is forbidden; only $__rate_interval is allowed.
Subtracting sums of two series also changes the series set and the aggregation semantics compared with the single Datadog series sum.
